hero.desc: Custom PETG thermoformed orthopedic implant trays, skin stapler packaging, dental implant trays, bone screw packaging — face seal blister components manufactured in Cleanroom Class 8 under GMP and ISO 9001:2015. Orthopedic packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat.

strips.title: Implant Articular Surface Contact — Scratched Implant is Rejected at QC
strips.desc: Problem: Orthopedic implant packaging where the PETG cavity contacts the articular surface (the polished bearing surface) creates micro-scratches that cause quality rejection — the implant cannot be used. Solution: Surface contact analysis from the implant technical drawing — cavity contacts only non-articular structural zones of the implant. Articular surface suspended in clearance.

strips.title: Heat Seal Flange Geometry — Tyvek Lid Cannot Seal Without Correct Flange
strips.desc: Problem: Orthopedic implant tray heat seal flanges with incorrect width, surface flatness, or corner radii cannot be heat-sealed correctly by the device manufacturer's sealing equipment — seal integrity failure or peel failure. Solution: Heat seal flange geometry confirmed from the device manufacturer's sealing equipment specification before tooling design.

strips.title: Cleanroom Class 8 — Particulate Contamination of Sterile Packaging Component
strips.desc: Problem: Thermoformed orthopedic packaging components produced outside cleanroom conditions carry surface particulates — fibres, dust, skin cells — that contaminate the sterile field when the device is opened. Solution: All PETG thermoforming for sterile orthopedic packaging produced in our Cleanroom Class 8 facility.

strips.title: Implant Surface Contact Analysis — Articular Surface Clearance Mandatory
strips.desc: Articular surface of orthopedic implant identified from device technical drawing before cavity design. Cavity contacts only non-articular, non-patient-contact surfaces of the implant. Zero contact with the polished bearing surface.

strips.title: Face Seal Flange Specification — Sealing Equipment Compatible
strips.desc: Heat seal flange width, corner radius, and surface flatness confirmed from the device manufacturer's sealing equipment and Tyvek seal validation specification. Flange geometry confirmed on first article before production.

strips.title: Cleanroom Production — All Orthopedic Packaging Components in Class 8
strips.desc: All PETG thermoforming for orthopedic sterile packaging produced in Cleanroom Class 8 at Vapi. GMP batch documentation per run.

strips.desc: Medical-grade PETG as standard for all orthopedic implant packaging. EO and gamma compatible. Material CoA per batch confirming medical-grade specification.

faqs.q: What orthopedics packaging does Trizen manufacture?
faqs.a: Custom PETG thermoformed orthopedic implant trays (hip, knee, shoulder, ankle), bone plate and screw packaging, skin stapler trays, dental implant trays, orthopedic surgical instrument trays, and trocar packaging blister trays. Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, ISO 9001:2015. Orthopedic packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat.

faqs.q: What certifications does Trizen have for Orthopedics Packaging?
faqs.a: ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8 (ISO 14644-1 — 100,000 particles/m³). All medical packaging components produced in the Class 8 cleanroom with full GMP batch documentation per production batch.

faqs.q: Is PETG compatible with EO sterilization for orthopedics packaging?
faqs.a: Yes — medical-grade PETG is compatible with Ethylene Oxide (EO) sterilization and gamma radiation sterilization. EO compatibility confirmed by material CoA per production batch.

faqs.q: What documentation is provided for medical device supplier qualification?
faqs.a: First article inspection report, dimensional inspection records per production batch, material CoA with medical-grade PETG specification per batch, batch records, ISO 9001:2015 certificate, GMP compliance documentation.

faqs.q: Why source orthopedics packaging from Vapi, Gujarat?
faqs.a: Orthopedic packaging manufacturer Vapi — Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, ISO 9001:2015. Orthopedic packaging manufacturer Gujarat for medical device companies. Medical packaging manufacturer from India for domestic and export medical device markets.

faqs.q: What is Trizen's scope for medical packaging?
faqs.a: Trizen manufactures the thermoformed PETG packaging component — the tray or blister shell. Device loading, Tyvek/foil lidding, heat sealing, and sterilization are performed by the medical device manufacturer. Clear scope for DHF traceability.
First article: 14 to 21 business days from device technical drawing or sample — cleanroom CNC tooling at Vapi. ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8 documentation per production batch.

faqs.q: Does Trizen supply medical packaging for export markets?
faqs.a: Yes — ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and medical-grade PETG CoA per batch for export medical device market compliance. Medical thermoforming packaging manufacturer from India for international medical device markets.
